music.prompt: Original instrumental, slow Bengali-inspired chamber piece at about seventy beats per minute: a soft tanpura drone, gentle tabla, a solo sitar melody answered by bansuri flute, not any known theme. It opens sparse and patient like monsoon rain, gathers warmth and hope through the middle, swells tenderly near the end, then settles on a single sustained sitar note over the drone.
